name: Checkly Hobby
free_limit: 10 uptime monitors; 1,000 Browser check runs and 10,000 API check runs/month; 1 user; 7-day raw data retention
watch_out: Hobby is an ongoing $0 plan for personal projects and learning; no credit card required. Its 10,000 API and 1,000 Browser check runs per month are HARD capped: checks stop running once the relevant credits are exhausted, rather than generating paid overages. One user, 7-day raw result retention and 30-day aggregated retention. On paid Starter/Team, checks continue past prepaid allowances and overage rates apply.
